# N-1 leaf equality. Shared by crypto/fs1_leaf.js and shear-fs1 src/leaf.rs.
# name, admitPub, commit, leaf or skip. A leaf is O || I || C, 96 bytes.
# I is E(Hp(admitPub)) with DST shear-admit-Hp. skip means the note takes no slot.
# s-ge-p is s >= p with the high bit clear. high-bit sets that bit on the base point.
# not-square is s=8. s=4 decodes to a valid point, so it is not this row.
# t-odd is s=2. Both are canonical-length field elements the ristretto decode rejects.
